sources.facts: Rostov heritage society: surviving provincial-classical facade at Grecheskaya40, rebuilt early19th century, one principal storey with service basement; Alexander I stayed/died here. Text facts only, no site photo or historical plan pixels used.

limits: The two own-photograph originals show only street front/left return, with temporary 2010 renovation. Whole native outline controls rear returns; hidden fenestration/roof pitches/heights/chimney locations/gate dimensions approximate. 2010 ochre/white repaint and green metal roof selected, no claim of current condition or original1825appearance. Other campus buildings excluded.
